mn55:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Jīvakassa Komārabhaccassa ambavane.
mn55:2.1: Atha kho Jīvako Komārabhacco yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Jīvako Komārabhacco Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn55:3.2: samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ uddissa pāṇaṃ ārabhanti, taṃ samaṇo Gotamo jānaṃ uddissakaṭaṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamman-ti
mn55:3.3: Ye te bhante evam-āhaṃsu: samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ uddissa pāṇaṃ ārabhanti, taṃ samaṇo Gotamo jānaṃ uddissakaṭaṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamman-ti, kacci te bhante Bhagavato vuttavādino, na ca Bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaronti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādāṇuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti. --
mn55:4.1: Ye te Jīvaka evam-āhaṃsu: samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ uddissa pāṇaṃ ārabhanti, taṃ samaṇo Gotamo jānaṃ uddissakaṭaṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamman-ti, na me te vuttavādino abbhācikkhanti ca pana man-te asatā abhūtena.
mn55:5.1: Tīhi kho ahaṃ Jīvaka ṭhānehi maṃsaṃ aparibhogan-ti vadāmi:
mn55:5.3: Imehi kho ahaṃ Jīvaka tīhi ṭhānehi maṃsaṃ aparibhogan-ti vadāmi.
mn55:5.4: Tīhi kho ahaṃ Jīvaka ṭhānehi maṃsaṃ paribhogan-ti vadāmi:
mn55:5.6: Imehi kho ahaṃ Jīvaka tīhi ṭhānehi maṃsaṃ paribhogan-ti vadāmi.
mn55:6.1: idha Jīvaka bhikkhu aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati.
mn55:6.2: So mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddham-adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharati.
mn55:6.3: Tam-enaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upasaṅkamitvā svātanāya bhattena nimanteti.
mn55:6.5: So tassā rattiyā accayena pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram-ādāya yena tassa gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkamati, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdati,
mn55:6.6: tam-enaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena piṇḍapātena parivisati.
mn55:6.8: sādhu vata māyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena piṇḍapātena parivisati,
mn55:6.9: aho vata māyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā āyatim-pi evarūpena paṇītena piṇḍapātena pariviseyyāti,
mn55:6.11: So taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ agathito amucchito anajjhopanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati.
mn55:6.13: api nu so bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye attabyābādhāya vā ceteti parabyābādhāya vā ceteti ubhayabyābādhāya vā cetetīti. --
mn55:6.15: Nanu so Jīvaka bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye anavajjaṃ yeva āhāraṃ āhāretīti. --
mn55:7.4: Tam-me idaṃ bhante Bhagavā sakkhi diṭṭho,
mn55:7.6: Yena kho Jīvaka rāgena yena dosena yena mohena byāpādavā assa so rāgo so doso so moho Tathāgatassa pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn55:7.7: Sace kho te Jīvaka idaṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ anujānāmi te etan-ti. --
mn55:7.8: Etad-eva kho pana me bhante sandhāya bhāsitaṃ.

mn55:12.1: Yo kho Jīvaka Tathāgataṃ vā Tathāgatasāvakaṃ vā uddissa pāṇaṃ ārabhati so pañcahi ṭhānehi bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavati:
mn55:12.3: gacchatha amukaṃ nāma pāṇaṃ ānethāti, iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavati;
mn55:12.4: yam-pi so pāṇo galappavedhakena ānīyamāno dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, iminā dutiyena ṭhānena bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavati;
mn55:12.6: gacchatha imaṃ pāṇaṃ ārabhathāti, iminā tatiyena ṭhānena bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavati;
mn55:12.7: yam-pi so pāṇo ārabhiyamāno dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, iminā catutthena ṭhānena bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavati;
mn55:12.8: yam-pi so Tathāgataṃ vā Tathāgatasāvakaṃ vā akappiyena āsādeti, iminā pañcamena ṭhānena bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavati.
mn55:12.9: Yo kho Jīvaka Tathāgataṃ vā Tathāgatasāvakaṃ vā uddissa pāṇaṃ ārabhati so imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavatīti.
mn55:13.1: Evaṃ vutte Jīvako Komārabhacco Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn55:13.3: Kappiyaṃ vata bhante bhikkhū āhāraṃ āhārenti,
mn55:13.4: anavajjaṃ vata bhante bhikkhū āhāraṃ āhārenti.
